summary: Amos reported a criminal-harassment matter (doc doc_muu0ij09_aa3e53, sha256 5721423b6bf358d4…). Complainant: Lauren Hofstee. Accused: her former boyfriend of about 3 years (name not given). Amos says the accused has stalked and harassed her with repeated contact, calls and text messages. Sunday 23 Aug 2026, at the Guelph Boathouse, the accused approached Amos’s co-ed softball team three times while they ate ice cream, spoke to the group, left, and came back. On the third approach (3–5 min after the second), the group walked to a car as he followed, still talking, and he was asked to leave. That night he sent an apology by text, which got no reply. The group reported it to Guelph Police that night. Officer Meghan Hern (spelling unconfirmed) called back. Amos says the accused was arrested the same day, released with conditions and charged with criminal harassment (Criminal Code s.264). Amos is a witness. Recipient of the apology text, exact times, the list of witnesses and the occurrence number are not yet recorded.

Published a private interactive case page for the Hofstee matter at https://claude.ai/artifact/YUhWQV2RWk8xwwsKr4kv4P. It has the timeline, the s.264 elements, a witness/complainant checklist, a statement template, support contacts and a gap-filling form. Amos's answers save to the db doc case/intake. Read them back with ArtifactData and journal each version. Ref j_muu0ij0b_bfdcd9.

Amos reports that Lauren Hofstee called the victim services program. She was told that any new evidence would have to be reported to police. Amos says Lauren does not want to talk to police and that they want to avoid contact with them. What the new evidence is, and which victim service she called (VWAP or Victim Services Wellington), have not been recorded. Amos asked what options exist.
